name: laneconductor
description: LaneConductor plugins: the planning and delivery workflow plugin, and two optional local add-ons (the board and the safe-writes connector).

plugins.name: laneconductor
plugins.description: The LaneConductor skill, slash commands and subagents for tracks kept as files in git. Markdown only.

plugins.name: laneconductor-board
plugins.description: Local add-on: the board generator, a static page of every track by lane. Needs a script that runs on your computer. Requires laneconductor.

plugins.name: laneconductor-connector
plugins.description: Optional local add-on: the git-backed MCP connector (conflict-checked writes, automatic commits, freshness warnings). Requires laneconductor.
